descriptions.acrobat: Jumps in a straight line over an adjacent token. Can jump twice in a row.
descriptions.leader:
The game ends if a leader is captured or surrounded.

A leader cannot end their action on a space where they would be captured.
descriptions.rider: Move by two spaces in a straight line.
descriptions.bruiser: Moves to an adjacent enemy’s space, pushing them to one of the opposite three spaces of your choice.
descriptions.manipulator: Moves a non-adjacent enemy, visible in a straight line, by one space.
descriptions.royal_guard: Moves from any space to a space adjacent to your Leader. May then move one additional space.
descriptions.illusionist: Switches places with a non-adjacent, visible character in a straight line.
descriptions.claw_launcher: Moves in a straight line all the way to a visible character, or drags them until they are adjacent.
descriptions.brewmaster: Moves an adjacent ally one space.
descriptions.wanderer: Moves to any space non-adjacent to an enemy.
descriptions.archer:
Can be two spaces in a straight line from the opponent’s Leader and help capture them. The Leader does not need to be visible.

However, does not help capture the opponent’s Leader when adjacent.
descriptions.assassin: Captures the opponent’s Leader when adjacent, even without a second ally.
descriptions.jailer:
Adjacent enemies with an active ability cannot use their ability.

Does not interrupt an action in progress if the enemy becomes adjacent during the action.
descriptions.protector: Enemy abilities may not move the Protector or any adjacent allies.
descriptions.vizier: Your Leader may move one additional space during their action.
descriptions.nemesis: Cannot take an action during their action phase. Must move by 2 tiles after any action moving the opponent’s Leader. If it is not possible to move by two tiles without going back to its original position, only moves by one tile.
descriptions.hermit_and_cub: When you recruit them, take both the Hermit and the Cub. These two characters count as one during the recruitment phase. You can move either the Hermit or the Cub, or one immediately after another. The cub cannot help capture the opponent’s Leader.
descriptions.sniper: At the start of your turn, the Sniper captures alone the opponent’s Leader from three or more spaces away in a straight line, even if the Leader is not visible.
descriptions.wisp: Move to any empty space on the board. Cannot help capture the opponent’s Leader.
descriptions.tactician: If an ally (Tactician included) is adjacent to the opponent’s Leader, the Tactician moves a non-Leader ally by one space. The relocated ally can no longer use their active ability this turn.
descriptions.elite_archer: Also helps capture the opponent’s leader from two spaces away in a straight line, even if they are not visible.
descriptions.shaman: Transforms a non-leader character, visible in a straight line, into a frog until the end of the opponent’s turn.
descriptions.frog: Moves up to two spaces. May pass through a space occupied by another character. Cannot help capture the opponent’s leader.
